newsitem.title: MEXICO: Colombian, Mexican drug traffickers found in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Colombian, Mexican drug traffickers found in Mexico.

text.p: A Colombian drug trafficker and his dead Mexican counterpart were found on Wednesday in a car trunk in Mexico City, the Federal Attorney General's Office (PGR) said in a statement late on Friday.

Mexican Natalio Pena Munoz and Colombian Fernando Restrepo Munoz were found together in the trunk of a Ford Fairmont in a southern district of the city, the PGR said. Colombian officials were advised of Restrepo's whereabouts, it added.

"The surviving Fernando Restrepo Morales...said that he and Natalio Pena Munoz did different narcotraffic related activities, transporting drugs from Colombia to the United States through Mexican territory," the PGR said.
The PGR did not provide further details.
